detaileddescription.para: Constructs MainComponent.

engine
The unified Lua engine — owns config and scripting state.
Member init order (declared in header):
config, appState — cached context references
action — global action registry (constructed after Config)
terminalLookAndFeel — application-wide LookAndFeel
fonts — global font context (from config)

Constructor body:
setOpaque(false) — tells JUCE the component has transparency.
initialiseOverlays() — creates overlays, shows startup errors.
setSize() — reads window dimensions from AppModel.
setDefaultLookAndFeel() — applies terminalLookAndFeel to all children.

Note: applyConfig() is NOT called from the ctor. It is called from Main.cpp after jam::Window is constructed. setRenderer is deferred further — it runs at the end of initialiseTabs(), after all Displays and their Screens are in the component tree, so that glContextCreated fires on all Screens when the GL context is attached.

Called by JUCE on every size change (including initial layout). Assigns full-bounds to tabs and messageOverlay; positions statusBarOverlay at top or bottom edge per keys.status_bar.position. briefdescription.para: Returns the content area available for terminal panes after subtracting chrome.

detaileddescription.para: Subtracts: title bar (when windowButtons is enabled), tab bar (when multiple tabs shown), and terminal padding from each edge. Used by the restore walker and fresh-tab dim computation to guarantee deterministic spawn dims from AppModel window size.

briefdescription.para: Root content component of the END application window.

detaileddescription.para: Placed inside jam::Window by ENDApplication::initialise(). Owns the terminal::Tabs container and paints the translucent background layer that shows through the native window blur effect.

simplesect.title: Layout
simplesect.para: resized() gives the full local bounds to terminal::Tabs; each terminal applies its own insets and title-bar offset internally.

simplesect.title: Background painting
simplesect.para: paint() fills with backgroundColour.withAlpha(opacity). The native blur layer beneath the window provides the frosted-glass effect; this fill sets the tint colour and transparency.
